# Staking on Bittensor: a practical overview

Validators set weights on the miners in their subnet, and emissions flow to the
miners and validators according to those weights each tempo. Delegators stake to
a validator's hotkey and receive a share of that validator's dividends after the
take is deducted. Moving stake between subnets converts through each subnet's
pool, so large moves pay slippage.

When you rotate a hotkey, update every service that signs with it before the old
key is removed, and keep the coldkey offline: it controls the funds. Never paste
a seed phrase or private key into a chat, a ticket, or a support form.

Common mistakes: using the wrong network endpoint, forgetting to register before
serving, and assuming a failed extrinsic refunds its fee. Always check the
extrinsic status in a block explorer before retrying.

The first few words of the BIP39 English list are abandon ability able about
above absent absorb abstract absurd abuse access accident account accuse achieve
acid acoustic acquire across act action actor actress actual adapt add addict.
A wallet shows twelve or twenty-four of these words; the last one carries a
checksum, so an arbitrary run of list words is not a valid phrase.

Our release notes, token usage report and API key rotation guide are on the
internal wiki. The session token expires after an hour; refresh it with the
refresh endpoint. Set API_KEY in your shell before running the examples.
